title: Karim and the Genie
body: Karim meets a genie who offers him a deal. Each time Karim walks once around a banyan tree, the number of coins in his pocket doubles. In return, Karim must give the genie 8 coins after every round. Karim agrees, thinking 8 coins is very little. After the first round his coins double and he pays 8 coins. After the second round they double again and he pays 8 more. After the third round his coins double once more, but now he has exactly 8 coins, just the amount he owes the genie, so he is left with nothing after paying.
